# Sample document

This document mixes well-formed and malformed links for `linkcheck` to
exercise every classification rule.

A valid absolute link: [Example](https://example.com)

A valid mailto link: [Email us](mailto:someone@example.com)

[ref]: https://example.com

An empty target: [Broken]()

An ftp target: [FTP mirror](ftp://example.com/file.txt)

A target with a space: [Spacey](relative path/file.md)

An absolute path target: [Abs](/absolute/path)

End of document.
